Purchase Invoice

The purchase invoice view displays comprehensive details about a purchase invoice received from a supplier.

This view shows all invoice information including supplier details, invoice date, due date, line items, tax amounts, and the balance due.

Available Actions

From this view, you can perform several actions:

• Edit the invoice by clicking the Edit button

• Print or save the invoice as a PDF using the Print button

• Email the invoice directly from the system using the Email button

• Create a payment against this invoice using the New Payment button

Payment Tracking

The view automatically displays any payments already made against this invoice.

The balance due is calculated automatically based on the invoice total and any payments received.

Each payment is shown with its date and amount, making it easy to track the payment history.

To learn how to create or edit purchase invoices, see: Purchase Invoice — Edit
